reason: τ²-Bench is a benchmark for evaluating conversational agents that coordinate with users in shared tool environments. Its primary contribution and experiments concern task/environment design and agent reasoning/communication performance; the paper does not propose or evaluate LLM inference, serving, decoding, or inference-time compression optimizations. It is outside this inference-efficiency collection.
title: τ²-Bench: Evaluating Conversational Agents in a Dual-Control Environment
